verdict.rationale: Rendering strategy is a fair axis for a UI framework like Next.js, so the story applies. The evidence describes Next.js only as a React framework, citing streaming, Server Components and automatic compiler configuration. Nothing shows a compiler-optimized rendering system that updates the DOM without virtual DOM diffing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a compiler-optimized rendering system that updates the DOM without a virtual DOM diffing step
